title: Execute custom-arch experiment batch (6 training runs)
description: Execute matrix cells arch=custom x strategy {sampler,class_weighted} x seeds {42,43,44} via src/run_experiments.py --batch custom --execute. 6 training runs sequential within batch. Long-running (minutes to hours). Checkpoints -> models/experiments/, metrics -> reports/experiments/runs/. Independent of batch 13 (resnet18) — runs can proceed in parallel with it. NO WRITES/EXEC WITHOUT APPROVAL.
approval_note: needs approval before exec — long-running training batch (6 runs)
acceptance_criteria: 6 checkpoint files exist under models/experiments/ (custom arch)
6 metrics json files exist under reports/experiments/runs/
Each metrics json has seed 42/43/44, arch=custom, strategy, val metrics, hyperparams
class_names order ('Damaged','Not Damaged') in every checkpoint
validation: ./.venv/bin/python -c "import json,glob; files=glob.glob('reports/experiments/runs/custom_*.json'); assert len(files)==6, files; [json.load(open(f)) for f in files]; print('ok', len(files))"
